name: Lee's Summit
intro_html:
Rally the corgi has sniffed out the best Christmas events for kids in Lee's Summit for 2026, and here is what he found: 16 family events, at least 2 of them free. The magic runs from November 28 (Belton Holiday Light Parade) through December 23 (Yaya's Alpaca Farm Annual Christmas in Garden City), with A Very Summit Christmas Concert (December 4), All Aboard with Santa on the Missouri River Runner (December 5 and 6) and the Holiday UTV Parade in Pleasant Hill (December 5) along the way. We check every date on the host's own website, and each listing links straight there.

What Rally found in Lee's Summit

  • 16 Christmas events for kids in Lee's Summit, counting 8 already live, 1 moving from the Kansas City page and 7 new ones, 4 of them from nearby Raymore, Belton, Pleasant Hill and Garden City
  • At least 2 free events among the new ones: the Belton Holiday Light Parade and the Pleasant Hill Holiday UTV Parade and Mayor's Lighting Festival
  • Meet Santa: All Aboard with Santa on the Missouri River Runner, A Very Summit Christmas Concert and a Santa storytime at the East Lee's Summit library
  • Trains: All Aboard with Santa on the Missouri River Runner (December 5 and 6)
  • Lights: the Raymore Christmas Tree Trail at T.B. Hanna Station (December 4 to January 1)
  • Season: November 28, 2026 to January 1, 2027 for the new listings
